description:
FILED s527d (2026-10-31).  `prove tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t` on a `git archive df8e1ec9` extraction (main's code) fails rows 1 5 7 9 11 12: `§4 flagged: my $m = 7%-3;`, `§12 flagged: $s += length($k)*length($k);`, `§28 flagged: my $x = $_.2;`, `§25 flagged: my $z = length("abc")-length("a");` and the two tool rows built on them.  The test asserts the expect-state checker FLAGS those shapes, but PCL's vendored PPI (branch pcl, groups A B F J) now lexes them like perl, so there is nothing to flag.  Not in the gate (tools/t).  Fix: the test picks its flagged shapes from registry rows that are still unfixed (fixed_in undef) or runs those rows with PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 -- never weaken it to 'not flagged'.

=== DONE (s531e) ===
Design chosen: the flagged shapes come from the REGISTRY (Pl/PPIBugs.pm), not a hand-written list -- so the test cannot go stale again when the next row is fixed on the branch.  tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t (commit de7d17f6): (1) every OPEN row (fixed_in undef) with a when.check kind is flagged on the vendored PPI with its kind and section, primary; its CONTROL spelling (a table keyed by section; an open row without one FAILS, so a new open row demands a control) is clean -- today §11 §19 §40 §48; (2) every row FIXED on the branch is NOT flagged on the vendored PPI (the fix and the checker agree); (3) the same fixed rows ARE flagged on the installed PPI when that is the version the row was confirmed on (a child process under PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 -- one process loads one PPI; skipped when no installed PPI, or another version), so every detector keeps a shape it is tested on (a kind several rows share, glob-for-multiply §12/§55, slash-as-division §11/§56, lexer-dies §6/§29, matches any of them); (4) the two tool rows use the first open row raising exactly one contradiction (today §19) plus its control.  Why not PCL_SYSTEM_PPI alone: it ties the test to an installed 1.291 that upstream may fix, and leaves the vendored lib -- what PCL runs -- untested.  12 rows -> 108, PASS (prove tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t); under PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 the file skips (its partition reads fixed_in 'pcl' as the vendored lib).  Found on the way: §47's repro was flagged with NO section (the generic label-not-at-statement-start rule had none) -- Pl/PPIExpect.pm now attributes it to §47 (attribution only, counts by kind unchanged).
subject: tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t fails 6 of 12 rows on main: its §4 §12 §25 §28 "flagged" shapes are lexed correctly by PCL's PPI since s527a/s527b
